predictions.prediction_text: If the VIX holds under 25 (ideally under 22) until Tuesday night, by Wednesday dealers will be offloading VX futures and buying ES futures leading to supportive price action and a volatility crush.
predictions.expected_result: By Wednesday dealers’ flows cause VX futures net selling, ES futures net buying, ES shows measurable intraday support and VIX declines (volatility compression) compared with Tuesday levels

predictions.prediction_text: March OpEx will prove supportive and if Tuesday was the bottom, tail-hedge demand after OpEx will strengthen the upward tendency and potentially catch the market off-guard (delayed lift).
predictions.condition: Tuesday is the bottom and March OpEx proves supportive
predictions.expected_result: Post-OpEx, ES exhibits a sustained lift over several sessions (higher closes and net positive returns) accompanied by increased tail-hedge buying demand

predictions.prediction_text: Positioning and high‑frequency mean‑reversion activity will keep return dispersion compressed, preventing an immediate vol expansion despite positioning that would otherwise favor it.
predictions.expected_result: Realized intraday return dispersion and realized volatility remain lower than levels implied by positioning, so implied vols do not spike over the next few sessions

predictions.prediction_text: Short‑vol trades and intraday call-side mean‑reversion (1–2 trades) present an edge with a cautiously bullish short‑term bias.
predictions.expected_result: Short‑vol and intraday call mean‑reversion trades executed over the next few sessions produce net positive P&L on average across the stated small number of trades
